toolsPreview.name: list_currencies
toolsPreview.description: List all supported currencies with name, decimal precision, minor units, and whether the pair is derived (triangulated). Use this before other tools to discover valid currency codes.

toolsPreview.name: get_rate
toolsPreview.description: Get the current — or historical, with date — exchange rate from one currency to another. Indicative developer-grade reference rates (aggregated market data + public reference rates), not for settlement or trading. Rates update ~60s for real-time currencies through the trading week when the live overlay is active; the source field on every response is the authoritative freshness indicator (live | ecb_daily | fred_daily) — rates fall back to ECB or FRED daily reference during market closures, data-source unavailability, or low liquidity. market_session on every response indicates open, weekend, or interbank_closed.

toolsPreview.name: convert
toolsPreview.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another at the current rate. Indicative developer-grade reference rates (aggregated market data + public reference rates), not for settlement or trading.

toolsPreview.name: get_range
toolsPreview.description: Get a daily time-series of exchange rates over a date range (business days). Capped at 366 rows per call; when has_more is true, pass next_cursor as the cursor parameter to fetch the next page. Indicative developer-grade reference rates (aggregated market data + public reference rates), not for settlement or trading.

toolsPreview.name: search_docs
toolsPreview.description: Search the exchangerate.dev FAQ corpus via BM25. Returns the top-K matching questions and answers with relevance scores. Use before answering how-to / pricing / data-sourcing questions so you cite the canonical text instead of guessing from training data.
